title: Courage and Boldness
definition: Courage and Boldness is Spirit-empowered faithfulness to speak, obey, endure, and stand for Christ without fear of people.
summary: Courage and Boldness is Spirit-enabled faithfulness to speak and obey despite fear, pressure, opposition, or cost.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reigns with all authority and gives His witnesses courage to confess Him before the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on faithful action when obedience feels risky. Biblical boldness is not harsh personality or reckless speech; it is confidence in God that enables truth, witness, and obedience under pressure. Courage grows from fearing the Lord more than man.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because fear often silences witness and weakens obedience. The Church needs boldness that is humble, prayerful, and Gospel-shaped. It helps believers stand without becoming combative or self-promoting.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for boldness before moments of pressure arrive. Speak truth with gentleness rather than shrinking back or lashing out. Remember that Christ is present when obedience is costly.
